product: Lakebase now supports PCI-DSS and HITRUST
tagline: Lakebase is now PCI DSS and HITRUST compliant for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled.
what_it_does: Lakebase is now PCI DSS and HITRUST compliant for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled. On AWS, this support is limited to the us east 1 region. On Azure, all regions where Lakebase is available are supported.
why_it_matters: Lakebase is now PCI DSS and HITRUST compliant for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled.
plain_summary: Lakebase is now PCI DSS and HITRUST compliant for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled. On AWS, this support is limited to the us east 1 region.
key_takeaway: Lakebase is now PCI DSS and HITRUST compliant for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled.
